verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has no built-in natural-language console, but its official MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your projects (trigger-dev-docs-12, trigger-dev-probe-4). The same server lets you converse with your chat agents from Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and similar tools without writing code (trigger-dev-docs-14, trigger-dev-docs-33). Natural-language operation therefore works, but only through an external AI client, and the evidence doesn't list which platform operations the MCP tools expose. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product, documented coverage of operations (trigger, deploy, inspect or cancel runs) through the MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
